'''Hat Lo''' was a [[human]] [[crime lord]] who visited the [[Outlander Club]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY]] with his [[Slavery|enslaved]] consort, [[Ayy Vida]]. While there, he availed himself of the private [[Cantina|bar]] of the [[Baath brothers]], who owned the club, while Vida entertained his associates and clients. Shortly after visiting the club, Lo boarded the [[AA-9 Freighter-Liner]] ''[[Jendirian Valley]]'', which departed from Coruscant and traveled to the planet [[Naboo]].

==Biography==
Hat Lo was a [[human]] [[crime lord]] who was on the rise<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> but not yet important enough to irritate or interest criminal syndicates like the [[Black Sun]]. On one [[Temperature|cold]] and [[Water|rainy]] [[Local day|night]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Lo and his<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Slavery|enslaved]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Twi'lek]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> consort<ref name="English">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}} {{C|English version only}}</ref> and partner [[Ayy Vida]]—<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" />who was forced to serve as his concubine against her will—took refuge in the warm and welcoming glow of the [[neon]] lights in the [[Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Vida frequented the club in the hopes that someone would free her from Lo.<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" />

The club was already falling out of favor with the more daring members of the fashionable elite, but Lo's assiduous presence marked the new kind of clientele that began to be found at the club. Such was Lo's ascent over the owners of the club,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the [[Baath brothers]],<ref name="Complete Locations" /> that he availed himself of their private [[Cantina|bar]] while Vida spoke with [[Achk Med-Beq]], one of Lo's associates,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and then entertained clients of the crime lord<ref name="Complete Locations" /> while stalling those who sought business with him.<ref name="CLNE">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref>

[[File:HatLoBrightened-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Hat Lo is visible between a disguised Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker, sat among other passengers inside the ''Jendirian Valley''.|Hat Lo (center) traveled on the ''Jendirian Valley''.]]
Shortly after visiting the club, Lo boarded<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[AA-9 Freighter-Liner]] ''[[Jendirian Valley]]'', which departed from Coruscant's [[western spaceport]] carrying [[refugee]]s and [[freighter tramper]]s and traveled to the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet [[Naboo]].<ref name="BMF50">{{BuildFalconCite|50|Starship Fact File}}</ref> During the journey, Lo sat in the hold of the [[freighter]] near the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="AOTC" /> who were traveling incognito disguised as refugees.<ref name="BMF50" />

==Personality and traits==
Hat Lo had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], light skin, and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="VE" />

==Equipment==
Hat Lo wore a floor-length blue [[robe]] with a very high collar.<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hat Lo appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Yby">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The ''Jendirian Valley'' scene was filmed in the art department depot of building 48 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> Lo can also be seen sat near Skywalker as Amidala wakes him from a bad dream on the ship in the deleted scene "Anakin's Nightmare."<ref name="Nightmare">{{Film|II}} Deleted Scene: Anakin's Nightmare</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Hat Lo was first identified by the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind", which was written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]].<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" />

Prior to the release of ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="Yby" /> [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]] was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in "[[Galactic Power Brokers]]," an article written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and published in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 10|''Star Wars Gamer'' 10]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Brokers">{{GamerCite|10|Galactic Power Brokers}}</ref> on [[May 7]], 2002.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020416.html|text=Episode II in Gamer #10}}</ref> The article did not associate Lo with the character seen in the film,<ref name="Brokers" /> with this connection first being made in "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," an article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 75|''Star Wars Insider'' 75]]<ref name="Insider75">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> on [[April 6]], [[2004]].<ref name="NewFace">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref>
